mapper.sql: s.SNAPSHOT_ID, s.ANALYSIS_DATE, s.RECEIVABLE_ID, s.CUSTOMER_ID, s.RECEIVABLE_AMOUNT, s.REMAINING_AMOUNT, s.AGING_DAYS, s.AGING_RANGE, s.RISK_LEVEL, s.TENANT_ID, s.ORG_ID, s.CREATE_TIME
mapper.select: SELECT AGING_RANGE as agingRange, COUNT(1) as receivableCount, NVL(SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount FROM TBL_AR_AGING_SNAPSHOT WHERE ANALYSIS_DATE = #{analysisDate} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY AGING_RANGE ORDER BY AGING_RANGE

SELECT s.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, c.CUSTOMER_NAME as customerName, COUNT(1) as receivableCount, NVL(SUM(s.REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount, MAX(s.AGING_DAYS) as maxAgingDays FROM TBL_AR_AGING_SNAPSHOT s LEFT JOIN TBL_AR_CUSTOMER c ON s.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID AND c.IS_DELETED = 0 WHERE s.ANALYSIS_DATE = #{analysisDate} AND s.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY s.CUSTOMER_ID, c.CUSTOMER_NAME ORDER BY totalAmount DESC

SELECT RISK_LEVEL as riskLevel, COUNT(1) as receivableCount, NVL(SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount FROM TBL_AR_AGING_SNAPSHOT WHERE ANALYSIS_DATE = #{analysisDate} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY RISK_LEVEL ORDER BY RISK_LEVEL

SELECT TO_CHAR(ANALYSIS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as month, NVL(SUM(REMAINING_AMOUNT), 0) as totalAmount, COUNT(1) as receivableCount, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN AGING_DAYS > 30 THEN REMAINING_AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) as overdueAmount FROM TBL_AR_AGING_SNAPSHOT WHERE ANALYSIS_DATE BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(ANALYSIS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

SELECT r.RECEIVABLE_ID as receivableId, r.CUSTOMER_ID as customerId, r.RECEIVABLE_AMOUNT as receivableAmount, r.REMAINING_AMOUNT as remainingAmount, TRUNC(#{analysisDate} - r.DUE_DATE) as agingDays, r.TENANT_ID as tenantId, r.ORG_ID as orgId FROM TBL_AR_RECEIVABLE r WHERE r.IS_DELETED = 0 AND r.RECEIVABLE_STATUS IN (0, 1) AND r.REMAINING_AMOUNT > 0 AND r.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId}
